category: Application Library examples: Wave Optics Module (2/2)
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Wave Optics Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Total Internal Reflection [Wave Optics Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Wave Optics Module (Waveguides): Total Internal Reflection. Physics interfaces: Electromagnetic Waves, Beam Envelopes (ewbe). Study steps: Wavelength Domain. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Wave_Optics_Module/Waveguides/total_internal_reflection") to solve it, comsol_example_info("total_internal_reflection", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Wave Optics Module > Waveguides > total internal reflection

parameters.description: physics interface Electromagnetic Waves, Beam Envelopes (API type ElectromagneticWavesBeamEnvelopes)

tools.notes: Library path Wave_Optics_Module/Waveguides/total_internal_reflection; model file 0.8 MB. Documented Java build script available (rebuild with comsol_run_example method='java'). Requires the module licence to open and solve.
